patch_description:
Add a sparse skip-3 CZ entangling layer to boost worst-group margin discrimination.

The current circuit achieves 0.66 score but has plateaued worst_group_margin at 0.35. 
The recommendation suggests adding CZ gates between qubits at distance-3 (skip-3 pattern) 
to improve robustness on hard-to-separate samples without excessive depth/parameter growth.

This implements the suggested skip-3 motif: pairs (0,3), (1,4), (2,5), (3,6), (4,7) 
with a single shared parameter "ent_skip3", increasing n_distinct_params from 7 to 8.
This maintains excellent parameter efficiency while adding targeted entanglement for 
worst-case sample discrimination.

The skip-3 pattern provides complementary long-range connectivity to the existing 
distance-3 CRZ block, creating multiple pathways for information flow that helps 
the classifier separate difficult examples.
